archive_credit: Denver Public Library Special Collections, X-23881; W. G. Chamberlain
observations: Two-storey horizontal timber siding; low hipped roofs and deep eaves.
Tall narrow sash windows with divided panes and projecting molded heads.
Brick chimney stacks; lower porch and an upstairs porch in a recessed wing.
Low front picket fence and taller plain side fence.
limits: Catalog does not supply a specific photo date. Do not label the photograph 1880 or infer an exact year from photographer lifespan.
Monochrome photograph establishes no paint hue.
Simplified building proportions and rear elevations are reconstruction. No identified people are modeled.
corroboration: NPS Italianate page dates style to 1850s–1880s and documents an 1877 residence and 1885 store/residence.
DPL Curtis Park article identifies late-1870s/early-1880s Denver Italianate residences.
NPS White Haven article documents bright green exterior paint in 1874. This establishes period availability, not the Denver photograph’s palette.
